limitations: Uses the existing local Gemma index of an authorized library; the active UI provider is separately tested and is not interchangeable.
Visual queries are broad diagnostic probes without a manually labeled full corpus. No nDCG or Recall quality claim.
Document controls derive from private leading content and are local only; they are not independent positive relevance labels.
Private content, titles, paths, original asset IDs, vectors, and derived private queries are omitted from the report.
Cached media were not re-encoded; current document vectors are checked against fresh encoding. Background correction is experimental.
